rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin (El camino's and El campo's); a box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]
rules.floor: the lake and its dock are built round the old picture: a place keeps its screen place, and its world point is the walkable surface under it (lago-set.html surfaceAt): the dock's planks (z 0.28) where the deck or its landing is under the screen point at that height, else the lawn (z 0) on the land side of the shore, else the water's surface (z -0.16). A frog place q: under (q.x + 16, q.y + 25); a person's, Canelo's, a duck's, a bird's, a boat's, the bread's, the bag's, the sack's or the flower's place (x, y): under (x, y - 1). So every position of lago.js, its stories and its pairs keeps its numbers, but those in moves and the story positions remap moves; the sheet names each one (spots, remap, code) with its world point
rules.relative: what the old code draws or moves relative to a person, the frog, a duck, a bird, a boat or the fish (what is carried, the brush, the bread in a beak, a splash, a wake, the bubbles) keeps its offsets
rules.sky: screen-space effects keep their old numbers: the stars of the happy endings (final18, final19, final20), the heart (heartAt), the birds' and the duck's circle in the sky (anima: 150 + 46 cos, 58 + 16 sin)
rules.view: one view, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window from x0 22, the old wide one
rules.pair: a review or level picture is pictures[word.side] (level: level[...].picture): zoom 2 = the 98 x 52 crop shown nearest-neighbour at 2 x 2 (every old picture of cual-lago is a 113 x 60 or 100 x 53 window: about 2 x). The old rectangles (remap cam and crop) say which pictures they were

layout.why: the brief and page 11 decision 9: the set stands on the world's axes; nothing is built square to the camera. The old picture had a horizontal far bank and a horizontal dock: neither can lie on a world axis. One straight shore along y keeps the old strip of lawn at the back on the left (Luis and Carmen sitting, Canelo) and the old left bank under the dock's root, and gives the lake more of the view than the old water had (water); the old far bank at the right becomes water, and what stood there moves onto the lawn up the shore (moves: Carmen of los-botes, the flower, the duck that climbs out, the bird of pájaro.si). The dock runs out from the shore along x; as every place on the old dock keeps its screen point (the frog, the children, the bag, the sack, the ducks that waddle onto it: on the screen a level row 100 px long), its deck is as wide as that row needs, on a world axis a row level on the screen runs across both axes. The post moved past the dock's end, the reeds to the shallows at the lower left: the right of the lake is where the ducks, the boats and the fish of the stories swim

behind.what: nothing: the sun and the clouds are baked into the set's sky (El camino's and El campo's); every bird, flying or perched, is drawn in front of everything as the old (its sort y + 200)

setKey.bakedWhy: order 06 found 10 states, made by five keys: bolsa (the bag of bread on the dock, mkBolsa), fila (how many pieces of bread lie in the row on the dock, mkPan), flor (the yellow flower), pincel (the brush the frog holds: drawn by rana()) and saco (the sack on the dock). Each is a thing drawn by the sprite layer (lago.js draw and rana()), none the day's light or the ground's, so they stay in the sprite layer as the old draws them (their places moved where moves says), and this one baked state draws all 10 (and every review and level picture)

front.how: the old background (fondo: the dock, its posts, the post) was drawn before everyone, and its reeds were in the sorted list; now the reeds, the post and the dock's mooring posts are set things someone can be behind. At its entry in the list lago.js draw sorts by y (sortY 9999: after everyone), for each item drawn before it (a child, the frog, Canelo, a duck, a bird, a boat, the fish, the bread, the bag, the sack: each item says what it is), the set's own pixels of the part (lago-set.html part(), PART_TAGS) are drawn again inside the item's box, only where that pixel is nearer to the camera than the item: bakedZ[i] > v / COS - (row + .5 - OY) * tan(30 deg) / S, v = (x + y) / R2 of the surface point under it (rules.floor: the deck's, the lawn's or the water's). "Behind the post" is that depth test, not a row
